notes.title: SOTG - UPDATE - 1.1.2
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
We do this Patch for Fix :
- Collision bug with a stone block in the 6th level of the Fortress
- Hiding zone not working in some levels of the Fortress
- Using icon some times still visible after launch a Spear or an Axe
- when you trigger the special attack too close to an enemy it does not take damage
- French corrections

Have a nice day everyone :)
Guild Studio Team

notes.title: Patch notes v 1.1.1.
notes.content:
Shadow of the Guild just updated! This time we wish you a happy new year along with our quality of life fixes:

[h2]Underground Boss Balancing[/h2]

The bosses ARE BADASS but we admit they were a bit too badass. We balanced the boss you find underground.

[h2]Panorama running[/h2]

When you go fast, you must see further. So now the camera moves further away while running so you see what dangers lies ahead.

[h2]Tpyos fiexd[/h2]

There was some texts missing on level four in the English version of the game. Now they are there. 

[b]Happy assassinations![/b]

notes.title: Shadow of the Guild 1.1.1 version
notes.content:
Shadow of the Guild has just been updated to version 1.1.1
On the menu (yes we are French everything is related to food):
- Balancing the underground boss, I named this dear Valik
- Camera adjustments to give more visibility, in motion, to the elements in front of Yaràn
- A correction of the English version or a text was missing in a sub-part of the pirate camp

Thank you to all the players for their support! Keep giving us feedback so we can improve the game :)

notes.title: SOTG 1.0.1
notes.content:
Version 1.0.1 - Patch note :

Thank you everyone who have played the game so far. You have found some bugs, and I have heard you. Bugs are now crushed for good :)

- PS5 Controller support added
- Skip ONLAP concert Fix
- Corrections on French Version
- Whip bug fix
